info.title: Mahjong Tournament Suite API
info.description:
The API of the backend: one HTTP Cloud Function (`api`, Express, Node 22, europe-southwest1).

- The apps never read or write Firestore directly (the rules deny everything): everything goes through here.
- **Authentication:** header `Authorization: Bearer <Firebase ID token>`, from `POST /auth/signIn`.
- **App Check:** the apps send `X-Firebase-AppCheck`. Today in *monitor* mode (it is only logged).
- **Errors:** always `{ error, message, details }` (see the `Error` schema).
- **Limits:** 600 writes/min per address, 120 per account; 600 reads/min per address on `/public`.

Documentation with diagrams: `docs/architecture/` in the repository.

On this page «Try it out» only works for GET: changes are made from the apps.

post.description:
✏️ Admin, or an editor assigned to this tournament (`tournaments/{id}/members/{uid}`).

Before the first hand: remove or add whole tables of 4. The app computes the new draw of every round; the server keeps the people who stay with their numbers, removes the chosen slots and can give the new slots to the waiting list. In a team tournament every team must end with 4 people (`PARTIAL_TEAM`), and people who stay can move to another team. It sends an email to each person affected and answers who did not get it. 409 TOURNAMENT_STARTED when a table has data. See docs/player-count-change.md.

post.description:
✏️ Admin, or an editor assigned to this tournament (`tournaments/{id}/members/{uid}`).

With the registrations closed: the app computes the rounds and the tables and places the confirmed people in the slots. 409 with `details.code`: REGISTRATION_OPEN, BAD_PLAYER_COUNT, IMPORT_PROBLEMS (a person with a place has no valid EMA number yet; `details.emaIds`), INCOMPLETE_TEAMS, BAD_ASSIGNMENTS or DRAW_MADE.

E400.description: Request not valid (`bad_request`). `details` says which field fails.

E401.description: No token, an expired token (`unauthenticated`) or App Check refused (`app_check_failed`, only in enforce mode).

E409.description: Conflict (`conflict`): the table changed on the server, the EMA number has an owner, the file has errors, the draw is not ready… `details.code` says which.

kind.description: DISABLE or DELETE, or null to only take the account out of the organizations of the caller.

newEmaId.description: Another EMA number, to fix a row of an import.

registration.description: Opens registrations: the tournament has no players and no draw yet.

globalResources.description: Revisions shared by all tournaments. Only the tournament manifest has them.

tableVersions.description: Exact version of each saved table. The key is `<roundId>_<tableId>`. Only tournaments have it.

details.description: Extra data, such as `{ code: "FILE_HAS_ERRORS" }` or the current state of the table.

permissions.description: The whole list that the account gets. Null keeps the changes that it has.

rolePermissions.description: What the account may do as EDITOR and as CLUB_ADMIN. Null from an older backend.

replaced.description: How many registrations the list has now: the import replaces them all.

emaId.description: The EMA ID of the account. An empty text clears it.

adminOrganizations.description: The organizations of a club admin, as organization ids.

base.description: Only when the role is created. The base of a role never changes.

doneAtMs.description: When the hand was marked done, in milliseconds since 1970. Null for older hands.

hasTableData.description: True when any table has data. The number of players cannot change then.

isPublic.description: False hides the tournament from everyone without an account in it.

showTableDiffs.description: False hides the differences button on the table screen of the player app.

permissions.description: What the signed-in account may do in the tournament, by permission name.

drawPending.description: True before the draw of a tournament with registrations.

organizerIds.description: Null keeps the organizers. A super admin or a club admin of the main organizer changes them.

permissions.description: The permissions that some role of the account grants somewhere. Null from an older backend.
